description: Adds utm_source, utm_medium (social by default), utm_campaign and optionally utm_content and utm_term to a link: one link per platform, or one for a source you name.

content.description: Tells posts in one campaign apart, such as reel-1.

platforms.description: Which platforms to make links for (all six by default).

source.description: One source of your own. Without it, you get one link per platform.

url.description: The link to tag; https:// is added when it's missing.

name: build_utm_links
title: Build UTM links
